title: Closing the feedback-feeding loop of the radio galaxy 3C 84
question: Do kpc-sized cold molecular gas filaments in NGC 1275 (host of 3C 84) flow onto and feed the circumnuclear disc (CND), closing the feedback-feeding loop of the AGN?

data.angular_resolution: beam 0.19 x 0.10 arcsec (P.A. = 4.8 deg), 68 x 36 pc
data.sensitivity: 0.36 mJy/beam per channel (new cube); 1 mJy/beam at 20 km/s in original cube

what.value: SMA CO flux integral of the inner and western filaments, 106.0 +/- 3.4 Jy km/s (western filament 34.1 +/- 2.3), used for comparison

evidence.quote: The combined flux integral of their inner and the western filaments, which correspond to most of the emission in our data, is $106.0 \pm 3.4$ Jy km s$^{-1}$.

what.value: Radial infall velocity of the filaments of order 200 km/s, used for the accretion rate

evidence.quote: In the models of Lim et al.(cite: Lim08) for the radial infall of the filaments towards the CND, they do so with velocities of the order of 200 km s$^{-1}$.

what.value: Standard-ISM alpha_CO = 4.3 Msun/(K km/s pc^2) and S_CO(2-1) = 2.4 S_CO(1-0)

evidence.quote: which are characteristic of a standard ISM(cite: Bolatto13)

what.value: X-ray cooling flow rate of at least 30 Msun/yr (O VI) and Halpha filament cooling rate of about 100 Msun/yr, used for comparison

evidence.quote: the disposition rate of at least 30 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ of the X-ray cooling flow derived by Bregman et al.(cite: Bregman06)

external_data.citation: Bregman et al. (cite: Bregman06); Fabian et al. (cite: Fabian11)

recipe.method: Single phase-only self-calibration of pipeline-calibrated visibilities using a point model for 3C 84
assumptions: 3C 84 is a point source at the phase centre for the model

recipe.goal: re-derive the bandpass using 3C 84 itself, iteratively
recipe.method: Bandpass solution from 3C 84 using only baselines longer than 500 klambda; line emission modelled and subtracted from the uv data, then bandpass redetermined; done twice
key_parameters: Baselines > 500 klambda, spatial scales smaller than about 0.4 arcsec
assumptions: Line emission is much weaker than the 3C 84 continuum so the bandpass error it induces is small

recipe.method: Imaging with natural weighting, 13.1 km/s channels, Hanning smoothing
key_parameters: Velocity resolution 26.1 km/s; beam 0.19 x 0.10 arcsec; noise 0.36 mJy/beam

recipe.goal: make moment images (integrated line and velocity field)
recipe.method: SoFiA-2 Smooth+Clip finder builds a mask from merged smoothed-cube masks; mask applied to the original cube to compute moments
key_parameters: Spatial Gaussian kernels 0, 3, 6, 12, 24 pixels; velocity boxcar kernels 0, 3, 7 channels; noise cutoff 4 sigma

recipe.goal: examine kinematics along filaments and the CND
recipe.method: Position-velocity diagrams along selected position angles and along filaments, plus velocity-field inspection, to judge infall onto the CND
key_parameters: PA 90 deg slice through the CND; PA 150 deg along filament D centred 0.3 arcsec W of the centre
assumptions: Filaments pointing toward 3C 84 with organised E-W kinematics are infalling, not pushed outward by the N-S jets

recipe.goal: measure flux integrals and derive H2 masses
recipe.method: Flux integrals of the full field, CND and filaments A, B, C converted to H2 mass with a CO-to-H2 conversion factor and a CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio
key_parameters: alpha_CO = 4.3 Msun/(K km/s pc^2) and S_CO(2-1) = 2.4 S_CO(1-0) (standard ISM); alternative alpha_CO = 0.8
assumptions: Standard Galactic ISM conversion factor as default; AGN-like lower factor as alternative
Most CO(2-1) emission recovered by the array

recipe.goal: estimate the gas infall rate onto the CND
recipe.method: Mdot = M_gas / t_dyn = M_gas (r/v)^-1 for filament gas within r = 0.7 arcsec (~250 pc), with infall velocity 200 km/s
key_parameters: Gas mass of about 5e8 Msun inside radius 0.7 arcsec (~250 pc) for alpha_CO = 4.3; v = 200 km/s
assumptions: Infall velocity 200 km/s taken from radial infall models; same conversion factor for filaments and CND

answer_key.quantity: Synthesized beam of the re-processed cube
answer_key.value: 0.19 x 0.10 arcsec, P.A. = 4.8 deg (68 x 36 pc)

evidence.quote: The beam size is 0$\overset{\prime\prime}{.}$19 $\times$ 0$\overset{\prime\prime}{.}$10 (P.A. = 4$\overset{\circ}{.}$8), corresponding to 68 $\times$ 36 pc
the noise level in the channels is 0.36 mJy beam$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: CO(2-1) flux integral over the entire field of view

evidence.quote: The flux integral over the entire field of view is $112.9 \pm 6.0$ Jy km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: CO(2-1) flux integral of the CND

evidence.quote: The flux integral of the CND is $22.2 \pm 1$ Jy km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: CO(2-1) flux integrals of filaments A, B, C

evidence.quote: $17.6 \pm 0.8$, $20.7\pm 1.0$ and $12.6\pm 0.6$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ respectively.
this gives a total H$_2$ mass of $2.79 \pm 0.14\times 10^9$ $M_\odot$

answer_key.quantity: H2 masses of filaments A, B, C (alpha_CO = 4.3)

evidence.quote: the H$_2$ masses are $4.4 \pm 0.2\times 10^8$, $5.2 \pm 0.3 \times 10^8$, and $3.1 \pm 0.2 \times 10^8$ $M_\odot$ respectively.
The H$_2$ mass of the CND is $5.6 \pm 0.3 \times 10^8$ $M_\odot$.

answer_key.quantity: Factor by which masses decrease for alpha_CO = 0.8

evidence.quote: all masses decrease by a factor 5.4.

answer_key.quantity: Infall rate of filaments within 0.7 arcsec (alpha_CO = 4.3 / 0.8)

evidence.quote: this gives an estimated infall rate of about 200 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$.
this reduces to $\sim$40 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$.

answer_key.quantity: Infall rate of filaments A and B (alpha_CO = 4.3 / 0.8)

evidence.quote: this gives an infall rate of $\sim$90 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$ or $\sim$20 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$, depending on the conversion factor assumed.

answer_key.quantity: Estimated disposition rate of cold gas onto the CND

evidence.quote: we estimate that the disposition rate of cold gas onto the CND to be in the range 20–200 $M_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Time to build the CND from the filaments

evidence.quote: it would take just several times $10^6$ yr to build the CND.

answer_key.quantity: Length and width of filament A

evidence.quote: has a length of about 2.7 kpc, but has a width of only $\sim$150 pc

answer_key.quantity: Length and width of filament B

evidence.quote: somewhat shorter and wider ($\sim$1.8 kpc long and 230 pc wide)

answer_key.quantity: Velocity displacement of a cloud from filament B at about 4 arcsec

evidence.quote: there is a small cloud which is displaced by about 200 km s$^{-1}$ from the main filament

score_reason: Data are public and the main pipeline is described (self-cal, bandpass from 3C 84 above 500 klambda, natural weighting, SoFiA-2 kernels and cutoff, alpha_CO values, infall formula) with numeric results, but self-cal and bandpass details, line subtraction and imaging parameters are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, flux integrals and H2 masses are numeric and the moment and mass recipe is largely given, though the custom bandpass step needs inference.
